'''2008 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 5–6 January 2008, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS14]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2008 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2008 Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]).

In December 2008, on the 2009 Match Play Championship preregistration thread, [[Scott Lingrell]] wrote that 48 players had entered the previous year's event and 4 of them did not show.<ref name="pcf-22347-357630">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=357630#357630 Preregistration List - 38], Scott Lingrell (CRingwell), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 December 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207045353/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=357261&sid=da800f192a94d4e0badb0ea8628c4ff7 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Site:''' Alternate Universes, 1530 DeKalb Pike, Blue Bell, Pennsylvania<ref name="sf-18222-252523">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=252523#p252523 Complete MPC Weekend Schedule and Information], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 December 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125010211/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18222 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 5–6 January 2008
* '''Winner:''' —

== Schedule and prizes ==

All events were held at Alternate Universes in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania, and [[Virtual Set 14]] was legal.<ref name="sf-18222-252523" />

* Friday 4 January: Booster Draft Event Team Championships, $10 a player, four games. Players drafted [[Reflections|Reflections I]] and [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] packs and kept the Enhanced Jabba's Palace promo cards; teammates played opposite sides and drafted from different pods.
* Saturday 5 January: the main event, in match play format (each player played the opponent with both decks, the winner of the match moving on), single elimination; seeds 1–16 had a bye in round 1, rounds 1–4 had 1:15 per game, and the final four went on to Day 2. Round 1 losers could play a free three-game sealed deck event, and players not in round 3 of the main event a six-game Swiss open constructed event with a final confrontation (free for main-event players, $10 for others), whose top player won an automatic bid to the [[2008 World Championship]] and whose top four split a $250 donation plus the extra entry fees 50/30/10/10.
* Sunday 6 January: the final four (11:30 am to 4:30 pm; rounds 4 and 5 at 1:15 per game), and a $10 Swiss consolation event for players not in Day 2, six games with a final confrontation, with an automatic bid to the 2008 World Championship for the top player and a 60/40 cash split for the top two.<ref name="sf-18222-252523" />

The top two of the main event received glass and automatic bids to the 2008 World Championship. First place received 50% of the entry fees, a $250 player donation and a $250 travel voucher donated by [[Justin Desai]]; second place 30% of the entry fees, and third and fourth 10% each.<ref name="sf-18222-252523" />

== Seeding ==

The Players Committee posted the seeding of the 48 entrants on 31 December 2007. Seeds 1–16 had a bye in the first round, and the field was split into four 12-player brackets named after the top four seeds.<ref name="sf-18222-252525">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=252525#p252525 Complete MPC Weekend Schedule and Information], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 December 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125010211/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18222 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Worlds bids ==

The Players Committee's list of 2008 World Championship Day 2 automatic bids, posted on 29 August 2008, gave the Match Play Championship's bids to [[Steve Baroni]] and [[Mike d'Amboise]], the 5 January MPC consolation event's bid to [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] and the 6 January MPC Day Two consolation event's bid to [[Brian Hollingworth|Brian Hollingsworth]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], Cedric (simone89), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref> On 4 September 2008 Cedric (simone89) wrote that the call on the MPC auto bids had been reviewed and that Mike d'Amboise had been given a Day 2 auto bid; he added that the decision also affected [[Nate Meeker]], whose case could be put to the review committee if Meeker would be back in the country for Worlds.<ref name="sf-22883-333776">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=333776#p333776 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], Cedric (simone89), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
